children: Singapore's 2027 growth outlook is more uncertain, as risks around the artificial-intelligence investment cycle rises, analysts at BMI, a unit of Fitch Solutions, say in a note. BMI's case remains that AI-related demand will keep supporting Singapore's electronics-manufacturing, wholesale-trade and logistics sectors. However, the regional semiconductor supply chain, which includes Singapore, could be disrupted by growing political scrutiny of data-center investments in the U.S. and tighter restrictions on mainland China's access to advanced U.S. chips. BMI maintains its 2027 GDP growth projection for Singapore at 3.5%, the midpoint of the official 2.5%-4.5% forecast range. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
